allow: Bash(powershell -Command "if \(Test-Path cpanel_dist.zip\) { Remove-Item cpanel_dist.zip }; Compress-Archive -Path dist\\* -DestinationPath cpanel_dist.zip -Force")

PowerShell($response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://xiaomictg-production.up.railway.app/api/financing" -Method Get; foreach \($r in $response\) { if \($r.nombre -match 'edna'\) { Write-Output "Nombre: $\($r.nombre\)"; Write-Output "numeroCuotas: $\($r.numeroCuotas\)"; Write-Output "cuotasPrevias: $\($r.cuotasPrevias\)"; Write-Output "Total cuotas en array: $\($r.cuotas.Count\)"; $paid = \($r.cuotas | Where-Object { $_.status -eq 'paid' }\).Count; $pending = \($r.cuotas | Where-Object { $_.status -eq 'pending' -or $_.status -eq 'overdue' }\).Count; Write-Output "Pagadas en sistema: $paid"; Write-Output "Pendientes/vencidas: $pending"; if \($r.cuotas.Count -gt 0\) { Write-Output "Primera cuota #: $\($r.cuotas[0].number\)"; Write-Output "Ultima cuota #: $\($r.cuotas[-1].number\)" }; break } })
